meta.method: Assign each cause/effect node to the existing bechina-based package whose essential nature it shares, considering polarity.

assignments.reason: Eating in holiness is the Torah's central practical eitza — the cause that produces sweetening, draws holy yirah into the mouth, and creates komat adam. Its essential nature is the act of drawing מלכות/יראה into the physical act of eating. The additions file notes that אכילה בקדשה appears only in eitza edges. Since the act of eating in holiness is fundamentally about drawing יראה into the mouth, its essential nature belongs to the יראה/מלכות domain of Package 2.

assignments.node_id: שלא יהיה נשתלשל מן הצער, חס ושלום, השתלשלות אל הסטרא־אחרא
assignments.reason: That the suffering should not cascade into the sitra achra — this effect describes the prevention of evil escalation. Its essential nature is the sitra achra / רצועה בישא / fallen yirah domain. The additions file identifies סטרא אחרא as belonging to Package 3. This node describes the evil domain that is being prevented from taking hold.

assignments.node_id: נעשה המתקה, שלא יתגבר הצער ביותר
assignments.reason: The sweetening is produced, so that suffering does not intensify — the positive effect of eating in holiness. Its essential nature is the transformation of suffering through holy yirah. The sweetening happens when holy fear (Package 2) replaces fallen fear (Package 3). The sweetening itself is a product of the yirah-domain.

assignments.node_id: ממתיק הצער והדין הבא מרצועה בישא
assignments.reason: Sweetening the suffering and judgment that comes from רצועה בישא — the positive effect of drawing holy yirah. Its essential nature is the holy yirah that sweetens/elevates the fallen fears. Package 2 (holy yirah) actively sweetening Package 3 (evil strap). The sweetening action belongs to the holy side.
The mouth becomes human stature — the effect of eating in holiness. The additions file places קומת אדם in Package 2. The mouth becoming אדם is the result of מלכות/יראה entering the mouth. Package 2.

assignments.node_id: מכניס את בחינת המלכות, שהיא בחינת היראה כנ"ל, לתוך הפה
assignments.reason: Drawing the aspect of malkhut/yirah into the mouth — a cause-node that produces komat adam. Its essential nature IS מלכות = יראה entering the mouth. This is the core mechanism of Package 2: holy yirah threading through (like the strap through tefillin) and sanctifying.
The mouth becomes an aspect of human stature — variant of נעשה הפה בבחינת קומת אדם. Same essential nature, Package 2.

assignments.node_id: שאוכל עם יראת־שמים, בקדשה ובטהרה כראוי
assignments.reason: Eating with fear of heaven, in holiness and purity as proper — a variant of אכילה בקדשה that explicitly names יראת שמים. Its essential nature is the holy eating that draws in יראה. Package 2.
Making the mouth into human stature — another variant of the komat adam effect. Package 2.

assignments.node_id: שבפתיחת פיו הוא בחינת אדני, בחינת שכינה מדברת מתוך גרונו
assignments.reason: When he opens his mouth it is an aspect of Adonai, the Shekhinah speaking from his throat — the highest effect in the eitza chain. The additions file places שכינה מדברת מתוך גרונו and אדם העליון in Package 2. Its essential nature is the full realization of מלכות/יראה in the mouth — the Shekhinah (= malkhut) dwelling in the throat. Package 2.

assignments.node_id: שנתעלה בחינת קומת אדם הנ"ל, ונעשה בחינת אדם העליון
assignments.reason: The human stature is elevated and becomes the supernal Adam — the highest effect. The additions file places אדם העליון in Package 2. Its essential nature is the culmination of malkhut/yirah entering the mouth and elevating it to the cosmic level. Package 2.

Wisdom and knowledge is the cause that produces yirah (the cause-edge: חכמה ודעת → יראה). Its essential nature is דעת / מחין — the intellect domain of Package 1. The Torah says 'ראשית חכמה יראת ה — wisdom produces yirah, and greater da'at means greater suffering/yirah. Package 1 contains דעת and מחין.

analysis_notes.eitza_flow_summary: The Torah's cause/effect chain: (1) חכמה ודעת [Pkg 1] → יראה [Pkg 2] (wisdom produces yirah — the strap through tefillin). (2) אכילה בקדשה [Pkg 2] → sweetens suffering [prevents Pkg 3 cascade] → draws מלכות/יראה into mouth [Pkg 2] → mouth becomes קומת אדם [Pkg 2] → becomes אדם העליון / שכינה מדברת מתוך גרונו [Pkg 2]. The flow: Pkg 1 (da'at/mochin) → Pkg 2 (yirah enters mouth via eating) → prevents Pkg 3 (fallen yirah/sitra achra) → Pkg 2 elevates to supernal Adam.
analysis_notes.structural_note: This Torah has a clean three-package structure: Package 1 (da'at/tefillin) is the source of yirah, Package 2 (yirah/malkhut) is the domain where all the practical action happens (eating, sweetening, elevation), and Package 3 (fallen yirah) is the evil that is being prevented and sweetened. The eitza chain runs almost entirely within Package 2, with Package 1 as the initial cause and Package 3 as the negative pole being overcome.
analysis_notes.note_on_eating: אכילה בקדשה is the Torah's central eitza mechanism but has no bechina edges in the dataset. It appears only as a cause in eitza edges. Its essential nature — drawing יראה/מלכות into the mouth — places it in Package 2, not as a standalone concept.
